text:
Dresden’s median asking rent sits at 9.53 €/m², up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 24.5 % over the past five years, placing the city 32nd among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market is balanced, with an average of 27 days on market and 30 % of listings let within a week.

Affordability remains moderate: the rent for a 60 m² unit is 572 € per month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 13.4 % and the vacancy rate stands at 2.7 %. Asking rents carry a 38 % premium over the 2022 census existing rent of 6.92 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.07 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 9.8 €/m² and 10.31 €/m², implying a 5.7 % increase.
